# 3 Axial Skyrmions  
- The reflection operation alters the sign of only one pion field, differing from the approach in refs.[3, 12, 7], where the antiSkyrmion is defined by changing all three pion fields' signs, resulting in a relative phase shift by π.  
- The definition applied here facilitates a more natural comparison with monopoles under similar conditions.  
- According to equation (3.10), the profile function reaches zero at a radius of s/2 from the Skyrmion (or antiSkyrmion) center, allowing the Skyrmion and antiSkyrmion to be joined continuously with vacuum fields outside each core.  
- Besides the basic ansatz (3.7) for initial conditions, more advanced initial settings were utilized using the rational map ansatz [11] featuring an axially symmetric charge n map.
